title.en: An Act Renaming the Barangay Bulwagan Elementary School in the Municipality of Hinoba-An, Province of Negros Occidental, as the Paz Vda De Escanilla Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Barangay Bulwagan Elementary School in the Municipality of Hinoba-An, Province of Negros Occidental, as the Paz Vda De Escanilla Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 1 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6693_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Barangay Bulwagan Elementary School locates in Barangay Bulwagan, Municipality of Hinoba-an, Province of Negros Occidental, is hereby renamed as the Paz Vda de Escanilla Elementary School.
